## 1. Setup and load libraries
```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Load standard analysis libraries
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(ggrepel)

# 2. Define input folder
input_path <- here("data", "SILAC_Phos", "pSTYA", "report.parquet")

# 3. Load the functions
source(here("R", "clean_diann_report_phos.R"))
source(here("R", "expand_phospho_report_pSTYA.R"))
```

## 2. Load and clean the data
```{r load-data}
#| message: true
#| warning: false
#| results: "markup"

report <- clean_diann_phos_data(input_path)
```

## 3. Report renaming and add metadata
```{r data-specific-renaming}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Clean Run Names
report$Run <- sub("^.*Human_", "", report$Run)

#Add T before 05
report$Run <- sub("05", "T05", report$Run)

cat("Number of unique Runs:\n")
cat(length(unique(report$Run)), "\n")

# 2. Add metadata columns in report
report$group <- ifelse(grepl("Ratio11", report$Run), "Mix_H_L", "Only_L")
cat("Unique groups:\n")
unique(report$group)

# 3. Save filtered data
output_dir <- here("results", "SILAC_Phos", "pSTYA")
arrow::write_parquet(report, file.path(output_dir, "report_filtered.parquet"))
```

## 4. Expand phospho report
```{r expand-phospho-report}
#| message: true
#| warning: false
#| results: "markup"

report_expanded <- expand_phospho_report(report)
cat("Dimensions of the expanded phospho report data:\n")
cat(dim(report_expanded), "\n")

#save the expanded report
arrow::write_parquet(report_expanded, file.path(output_dir, "report_expanded.parquet"))
```

## 5. Phosphosite Count
```{r phosphosite-count}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: "markup"
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 6

# 1. Add residue info
report_site <- report_expanded %>%
  # Add amino acid column by extracting the first letter of the site string (which is the amino acid)
  mutate(aa = substr(site, 1, 1)) %>%
  # If Residue is STY, write "STY", otherwise keep the original residue (which will be A for decoys)
  mutate(residue = ifelse(aa %in% c("S", "T", "Y"), "STY", aa))

# 2 Count phosphosites by localization probability thresholds

# A. Create a function to calculate phosphosites count for a given threshold
count_func <- function(data, threshold) {
  data %>%
    filter(loc.prob >= threshold) %>%
    group_by(Channel, group, Run, aa) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(psite.id), .groups = "drop")
}

# B. Define thresholds
thresholds <- c("all" = 0, "0.75" = 0.75, "0.90" = 0.90, "0.99" = 0.99)

# C. Run the function for each threshold
count_list <- lapply(names(thresholds), function(t_name) {
  count_func(report_site, thresholds[[t_name]]) %>%
    mutate(
      localization = t_name,
      residue = ifelse(aa %in% c("S", "T", "Y"), "STY", aa)
    )
})

# D. Combine into one data frame
ps_loc <- bind_rows(count_list)
ps_loc$localization <- factor(ps_loc$localization, levels = c("all", "0.75", "0.90", "0.99"))

# E. Calculate mean and st.dev
ps_count_summary <- ps_loc %>% 
  group_by(localization, Channel, group, residue, aa) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(n, na.rm = TRUE), 
    st.dev = sd(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Channel = factor(Channel, levels = c("L", "M", "H"))) %>%
  # Complete the grid to ensure no missing bars
  complete(localization, Channel, group, nesting(residue, aa), 
           fill = list(mean = 0, st.dev = 0))

# F. Calculate Totals for Labels (So they don't stack/overlap)
total_labels <- ps_count_summary %>%
  filter(group == "Only_L") %>%
  group_by(localization, Channel, group, residue) %>%
  summarise(total_mean = sum(mean), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Plot Psite Count

# A. Version with aa as the grouping variable (S, T, Y vs A)
p_aa <- ggplot(ps_count_summary, aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = Channel)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity", 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
    color = "black",
    width = 0.7,
    lwd = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ifelse(mean - st.dev < 0, 0, mean - st.dev), 
        ymax = mean + st.dev),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = mean + st.dev, label = round(mean, 0)),
    vjust = -0.5, # Moves text slightly above the point defined in 'y'
    size = 3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  facet_grid(aa ~ localization, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Phosphosite count by amino acid and localization threshold",
    y = "Psite ID Count",
    x = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
print(p_aa)

# B. Version with residue as the grouping variable (STY vs A)
ps_count_summary$aa <- factor(ps_count_summary$aa, levels = c("Y", "T", "S", "A"))
p_residue <- ggplot(ps_count_summary %>% filter(group == "Only_L"),
                    aes(x = Channel, y = mean, fill = aa)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = "stack",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.7,
    lwd = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(mean > 0, round(mean, 0), "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = total_labels,
    aes(
      x = Channel,
      y = total_mean,
      label = round(total_mean, 0),
      fill = NULL
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3,
    color = "darkblue"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  facet_grid(residue ~ localization, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Phosphosite count by residue group and localization threshold (Only_L)",
       y = "Psite ID Count", 
       x = "") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      size = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
print(p_residue)
```

## 6. Count N_target and N_decoy from predicted library
```{r correction}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

# NOTE: The library is too large for GitHub or Proteome Exchange
# This code is shown for reproducibility
# The output (N_counts_predicted_library.csv) is already included in the repo

# 1. Load the predicted library (User: Update this path if re-running)
lib_path <- "path/to/your/predicted_pSTYA.parquet"
predicted_lib <- arrow::open_dataset(lib_path, format = "parquet")

# 2. Count N_target and N_decoy
n_counts <- predicted_lib %>%
  select(Precursor.Id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pA = grepl("A\\(UniMod:21\\)", Precursor.Id),
    is_pSTY = grepl("[STY]\\(UniMod:21\\)", Precursor.Id)
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    N_decoy = sum(is_pA, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_target = sum(is_pSTY, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  collect()

# 3. Save n_counts
write.csv(n_counts, "N_counts_predicted_library.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 7. Calculate The False Localization Rate (FLR)
```{r FLR}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Load correction factors
n_counts <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "N_counts_predicted_library.csv"))
cat("Counts of N_decoy and N_target in the predicted library:\n")
print(n_counts)

# 2. Calculate Correction Factor
correction_factor <- (n_counts$N_decoy + n_counts$N_target) / n_counts$N_decoy
cat("Correction factor calculated from the predicted library:\n")
print(correction_factor)

# 3. Precursor Count (Identified Target and Decoy hits)

# A. Define counting function
calculate_hits <- function(data, threshold) {
  data %>%
    filter(loc.prob >= threshold) %>%
    # Extract residue from psite.id
    mutate(residue = substr(site, 1, 1)) %>%
    group_by(Channel, group, residue) %>%
    summarise(hits = n_distinct(Precursor.Id), .groups = "drop")
}

# B. Define thresholds
thresholds <- c("all" = 0, "0.75" = 0.75, "0.90" = 0.90, "0.99" = 0.99)

# C. Run phospho precursor counts for each bin and store results in a list 
results_list <- lapply(names(thresholds), function(name) {
  calculate_hits(report_expanded, thresholds[[name]]) %>%
    mutate(localization_threshold = name)
})

# 4. Calculate FLR
final_flr_table <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(residue == "A", "Decoy", "Target")) %>%
  group_by(localization_threshold, Channel, group, type) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(hits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type,
              values_from = count,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Raw_Error_Rate = Decoy / (Target + Decoy),
    Raw_Error_Rate_Percent = Raw_Error_Rate * 100,
    Adjusted_FLR_Percent = (correction_factor * Raw_Error_Rate) * 100,
    localization_threshold = factor(localization_threshold, levels = c("all", "0.75", "0.90", "0.99"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(localization_threshold, Channel, group)

cat("False Localization Rate (FLR) at each localization threshold:\n")
print(final_flr_table %>% select(localization_threshold, Channel, group, Raw_Error_Rate_Percent, Adjusted_FLR_Percent), n = Inf, width = Inf)

# 5. Export to CSV
write.csv(final_flr_table, file.path(output_dir, "Localization_FLR.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 8. Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) of localization probabilities
```{r CDF}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 6

# 1. Aggregate site by run
plot_data <- report_site %>%
  group_by(Channel, group, aa, psite.id) %>%
  summarize(max_prob = max(loc.prob, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
# 2. Calculate the rank/percentage for each residue group
  group_by(group, aa, Channel) %>%
  arrange(max_prob) %>%
  mutate(cum_prop = (row_number() / n()) * 100)

# 3. Create the plot
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = cum_prop, y = max_prob, color = aa)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("S" = "#4A69BD", "T" = "#78909C", 
                                "Y" = "#D1D8E0", "A" = "#B71C1C")) +
  labs(x = "Identified Phosphosites, %",
       y = "Localization Probability",
       color = "Amino acids:") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  facet_grid(group ~ Channel) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.5, 1.0), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80")
print(p)
```

## 9. Plot FLR vs Target ID Continuous Curve
```{r plot-flr-curve-continuous}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 6

# 1. Create a fine grid of 100 thresholds (0.00 to 0.99)
smooth_thresholds <- seq(0, 0.99, by = 0.01)

# 2. Calculate hits for every single threshold to create a smooth line
smooth_list <- lapply(smooth_thresholds, function(t) {
  # Reusing your existing calculate_hits function
  calculate_hits(report_expanded, t) %>%
    mutate(loc_prob = t) # Store the numeric probability
})

# 3. Calculate the FLR for the smooth curve
smooth_flr_table <- bind_rows(smooth_list) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(residue == "A", "Decoy", "Target")) %>%
  group_by(loc_prob, Channel, group, type) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(hits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  # Fill NAs with 0 in case some thresholds have no Decoys or Targets left
  mutate(
    Target = replace_na(Target, 0),
    Decoy = replace_na(Decoy, 0),
    Raw_Error_Rate = ifelse((Target + Decoy) == 0, 0, Decoy / (Target + Decoy)),
    # correction_factor is carried over from Chunk 7
    Adjusted_FLR_Percent = (correction_factor * Raw_Error_Rate) * 100
  )

# 5. Create a specific column for the labels to plot
smooth_flr_table <- smooth_flr_table %>%
  mutate(
    label_text = case_when(
      round(loc_prob, 2) == 0.00 ~ "No cutoff",
      round(loc_prob, 2) == 0.75 ~ "0.75",
      round(loc_prob, 2) == 0.90 ~ "0.9",
      round(loc_prob, 2) == 0.99 ~ "0.99",
      TRUE ~ "" # Leave all other points blank so they don't print text
    )
  )

# Extract JUST the labeled points to draw lines and text
labels_data <- smooth_flr_table %>% filter(label_text != "")

# 6. Plot the curve
p_smooth_curve <- ggplot(smooth_flr_table, aes(x = Adjusted_FLR_Percent, y = Target, color = Channel)) +
  # A. The continuous line
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  
  # B. Vertical dashed lines dropping to the x-axis
  geom_segment(
    data = labels_data,
    aes(
      x = Adjusted_FLR_Percent, xend = Adjusted_FLR_Percent,
      y = 0, yend = Target, color = Channel
    ),
    linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # C. The dots on the curve
  geom_point(data = labels_data, size = 3) +
  
  # D. Top Labels (Probability Thresholds)
  geom_text_repel(
    data = labels_data,
    aes(label = label_text),
    size = 4,
    nudge_y = max(smooth_flr_table$Target, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.08,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # E. Bottom Labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = labels_data,
    aes(
      x = Adjusted_FLR_Percent,
      y = 0,
      label = paste0(round(Adjusted_FLR_Percent, 2), "%"),
      color = Channel
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = -0.2,
    direction = "x",
    nudge_x = -0.15,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # F. Layout and Styling
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  expand_limits(y = 0) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 5)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Identified Targets vs. False Localization Rate", 
    x = "Adjusted FLR [%]", 
    y = "Phosphosite IDs"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
print(p_smooth_curve)
```
